items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025

ctx.x: [Inaudible] The things that led up to that — as Max Roach pointed out years ago when he was being complimented for his innovations on the drums, he said, “I’m just standing on the shoulders of those who came before.” And I firmly believe that. And I’ve tried to pass that on and hopefully they get it. These guys have like so much ability on the drums at their age and they’re like teenagers, like I was. They’re in school but they can really play the drums, you know, whereas I had to learn to play the drums when I…
